description.narrative: The project provides technical assistance to countries for the planning and implementation of their third generation of the National Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) process. This will be done through three different workstreams. At the international and regional level, scientific research, assessments and reports the project produces reports to assist countries to raise their climate ambition with evidenced-based information and guidance. To support planning and target setting at national and sub-national levels, the project develops and pilot a methodology/framework to integrate NDC process with other development planning instruments (e.g. in biodiversity, energy, adaptation). To ensure NDC 3.0 targets can be financed and therefore achieved, the project also provides in-depth assessment of the financial needs and gaps, sectoral assessment and pathways as well as tailored assistance in the development of investment plans, project pipelines as well as needed capacity building.
